description: This file defines a UI component named 'ErrorState' using the LightningJS framework. It displays an error message with styled elements, including background and text, with properties driven by theme variables or a passed message.

classes.name: ErrorState
classes.description: A LightningJS component that renders an error message box with styled background and text, customizable via props.

methods.name: surfaceColor
methods.description: Computes the surface color from the theme for the component's background.

methods.name: errorColor
methods.description: Computes the error color from the theme for the component's error background.

methods.name: textColor
methods.description: Computes the text color from the theme for display text.

methods.name: radiusLg
methods.description: Retrieves large radius value from theme for styling element corners.

methods.name: radiusLgOutline
methods.description: Calculates outline radius by adding 2 to large radius value.

methods.name: msg
methods.description: Returns the message prop if provided; otherwise defaults to a standard error message.
